This tool allows you to:

1) Unwarp a VR video to reduce the distortion necessary for the image to be seem properly though the lenses of VR headsets.

2) Split a VR video into individual left and right images (necessary for extraction). 3) Join, the left and right images back together into a single frame.

4) Rewarp the image back into a proper VR projection.

Right click and edit the batch files to direct the program to the folder where your files are located.

The process for creating a VR video is the following:

1) Use the unwarp tool on the source video. Make sure you have the right resolution specified in the bat file.

2) Split the unwarped video into left and right images.

3) Extract those frames.

4) Copy the generated alignments copy paste the cooy on a different location. Don't touch the images in the alignments folder where alignments.json is located. Instead, delete all unwanted images from the copy folder.

5) Train your model using the copy alignments folder.

6) Go through the conversion process using the images from the unmodified alignments folder.

7) Grab all of the frames inside the merged folder and place them into the folder where the split source images are located. Confirm that you want to replace existing files.

8) Use the join tool on those frames to generate side by side images.

9) Compile all the frames into a video. You can rip the audio from the original video and add it back, if you please.

10) Run the rewarp tool to change the video back to an appropriate VR projection. Again make sure you have the right resolution specified. You may have to change the ipd in the bat fike if the images look too far appart. Note: The rewarp tool on the main folder seems to be broken, use the advanced version in one of the subfolders. You have to move it into the same folder where the .exe is located for it to work

11) VFR - Virtual Faking Reality!

Take into consideration that different VR videos seem to use different types of projection. I have no idea how, or if this tool can determine which one is being used.
